page.overview:
What is Khiron?

Khiron was the centaur who raised Akhilles, Asklepios, and Jason. In some versions he is the only centaur who was wise instead of foolish, in other versions he is a son of Kronos and Philyra, and Kronos took the form of a horse so Rhea would not know it was him.

Another name for Khiron is Chiron, that name can easily be mistaken for Charon, Hades'.
